This Certificate does not bestow any form of legal international approval. The conformity is established in the Report No. 1.12-4017690, Revision 2 (11 pages). The metrology results of tests and examinations provided in the Test Reports No. 1.12-4017690/2 (51 pages) and 1.12-4017690/3 (38 pages).
